newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez says Belgium re-assured over SGB, Tractebel.
newsitem.headline: Suez says Belgium re-assured over SGB, Tractebel.

text.p: Gerard Mestrallet, management chairman of the new Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux group, said on Friday that clarifications on his part to Belgian authorities on the independece of Tractebel had been favourably received.

He told a news conference that Belgium was concerned about a possible misuse by Ste Generale de Belgique of its 65 percent stake in Tractebel, as well as the possibility of a conflict of interest. SGB is 63 percent owned by Suez.
"These questions will be further clarified by Societe Generale de Belgique and Tractebel. The clarifications that we have given to the Belgian government were favourably received," he said.
Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux will be formed from the merger of Lyonnaise des Eaux and Cie de Suez.
